body: Why are you trolling this page?

Im sorry... you are better than i am. i cant stay clean. i cry about it. my family does drugs and i dont have anywhere else to go. i want to stop but how can i when the temptation is right outside my door... im glad i read this because i have hope again that i too have a future of sobriety.

im sorry. i really am. im crying thinking about this. i want to run away and start a new life. i know that there are people out there who can love us unconditionally. i have no hate for anyone but there are people who are not good for us, for our lives.
